card.name: Linking words in drug interaction statements
card.fires_on: Small linking or verb words right after a named drug in drug-interaction text, such as "or", "and", "did", "may", just before the second drug or the effect is named.

modes.label: Conjunction after first drug
modes.description: The word "or" or "and" joins two drugs or drug classes in an interaction statement.
modes.example: Both digitalis glycosides<< and>> beta-blockers slow atrioventricular

modes.label: Verb after drug subject
modes.description: A helper or effect verb follows a drug name that is the subject of an interaction claim.
modes.example: Nifedipine<< did>> not alter the plasma levels of varden

modes.label: Other stray spots
modes.description: Occasional hits partway through a drug name or in non-medical text.
modes.example: Monitor patients receiving emtricitabine and<< ten>>ofovir disoproxil f
